root_cause.text: Missing validation that outpages >= inpages in z_erofs_lz4_handle_overlap() causes unsigned underflow when crafted extents have m_llen < m_plen, leading to out-of-bounds array access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds "rq->outpages >= rq->inpages" condition; CVE description states "outpages - inpages wraps to a large value and the subsequent rq->out[] access reads past the decompressed_pages array."

intent_record.intent_summary: Add guard to prevent buffer underflow when handling in-place LZ4 decompression overlap in erofs.
intent_record.what: Added condition check `rq->outpages >= rq->inpages` to the existing if-statement in the in-place overlap handling path.
intent_record.how: This ensures that the loop indexing `rq->out[rq->outpages - rq->inpages + i]` does not become negative, preventing potential out-of-bounds access when output pages are fewer than input pages.

grouping_result.intent: Add guard to prevent buffer underflow when handling in-place LZ4 decompression overlap in erofs.

relevance_review.reason: The group adds validation to prevent the unsigned underflow that occurs when outpages < inpages, directly addressing the root cause.

candidates.rationale: Unsigned subtraction rq->outpages - rq->inpages underflows when outpages < inpages, causing out-of-bounds array access.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement performs unsigned subtraction rq->outpages - rq->inpages without validating that outpages >= inpages. When outpages < inpages (crafted extents with m_llen < m_plen), the subtraction underflows to a large unsigned value, causing out-of-bounds access on the rq->out[] array.
